metadata.description: Jody's portable pro dev skill stack

plugins.name: pro-core
plugins.description: Core dev skills: brainstorming, TDD, debug, planning, worktrees, subagent-driven dev. SessionStart hook reminds Claude to dispatch independent subagents in parallel.

plugins.name: pro-quality
plugins.description: Quality gate skills: requesting + receiving code review, verification-before-completion. Recommended companion: playwright from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js stack marker; recommended companions: vercel + figma from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-design
plugins.description: Frontend design skills: design tokens, accessibility audit (WCAG 2.2 POUR), motion system, typography scale, shadcn/ui composition. Companion: figma from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-testing
plugins.description: Testing skills: Vitest, Playwright automation, Storybook interactions, visual testing. Recommended companion: playwright from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-data
plugins.description: Data & auth skills: Drizzle ORM (architecture + schema), Prisma schema patterns, NextAuth/Auth.js patterns

plugins.name: pro-spec
plugins.description: Spec-driven development skills: writing feature specs (PRDs with Given/When/Then), clarifying specs (10-category ambiguity taxonomy). Adapted from github/spec-kit

plugins.name: pro-starter
plugins.description: Meta-plugin: installs Jody's full pro dev stack (7 skill-bearing plugins)
